import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Setup directories
input_dir = "./input"
output_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data - inspect paths
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv")

# Get feature columns from sample submission template
feature_columns = [c for c in train_df.columns if c != "id" and c != "species"]
print(f"Using {len(feature_columns)} feature columns")

# Load target labels
y_train = train_df["species"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Encode labels
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
y_train_encoded = label_encoder.fit_transform(y_train)
unique_classes = len(label_encoder.classes_)

# Features
X_train = train_df[feature_columns].values
X_test = test_df[feature_columns].values

# IMPROVEMENT: Apply StandardScaler fit-only on training data, transform ALL arrays
# This ensures no distribution drift affects validation/test scores
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(
    train_df.loc[train_df.sample(frac=0.2, random_state=42), feature_columns].values
)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# Split training for genuine validation (NEVER refit on validation data)
X_trn, X_val_full, y_enc_trn, y_enc_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_scaled,
    y_train_encoded,
    test_size=0.25,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_encoded,
)

# Train XGBoost with improved hyperparameters
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=7,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.9,
    colsample_bytree=0.9,
    min_child_weight=3,
    gamma=0,
    alpha=1,
    scale_pos_weight=1,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
    verbosity=0,
    random_state=42,
    tree_method="hist",
    use_label_encoder=False,
    early_stopping_rounds=100,
)

model.fit(X_trn, y_enc_trn, eval_set=[(X_val_full, y_enc_val)], verbose=False)


# Validation function for multi-class logloss
def calc_logloss(y_true, y_prob):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_prob_clipped = np.clip(y_prob, eps, 1 - eps)
    y_prob_norm = y_prob_clipped / y_prob_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    prob_at_labels = y_prob_norm.astype(float)[np.arange(len(y_prob)), y_true]
    log_values = np.log(prob_at_labels + 1e-15)
    return -np.mean(log_values)


# Validate on truly held-out split (never trained on validation data)
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_full)
val_loss = calc_logloss(y_enc_val, val_probs)
print(f"Genuine Hold-Out Validation LogLoss: {val_loss:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Generate submission matching sample_submission format
submission_rows = []
for i, row_id in enumerate(test_ids):
    sub_row = {"id": int(row_id)}
    prob_row = test_probs[i]
    for j, species_name in enumerate(label_encoder.classes_):
        sub_row[species_name] = round(float(prob_row[j]), 6)
    submission_rows.append(sub_row)

submission = pd.DataFrame(submission_rows)
submission.to_csv(f"{output_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Final evaluation metric
print(f"Evaluation Metric (multi-class-log-loss on validation set): {val_loss:.6f}")
